retry_stale: This item no longer has failed handling to retry
item_done: the inbox item was filed: nothing was sent
save_failed: the inbox item could not be saved
cannot_reply: this item cannot be replied to
reply_text_only: this device can only reply with text
doc_change_required: ref, field and value are required
answer_only: this device can only confirm a reply or a conclusion as text
suggestion_action: action must be confirm, reject or instruct
parent_kind: parent kind must be inbox, todo, session or agent
parent_id: parent id must be 1–256 printable characters; a personal Agent's is <source>:<sessionKey>
parent_cycle: that parent would make a cycle
parent_deep: that parent would sit the item too deep (at most 8 levels)
bulk_limit: too many items in one request
bulk_action: action is done, dismiss or reopen
merge_too_few_rows: pick at least two rows to merge
merge_none: nothing to merge: the rows are gone or already merged
merge_failed: the merge could not be saved; nothing changed
todo_targets: pick the rows to add to to-dos
todo_suggestion: the to-do needs a title and a due day or time that can be read
bulk_filter: a filter files open items as of a list: as_of is required, and reopen takes ids
document_only: only document items have a status to change
cannot_mute: this item cannot be muted by that
no_doc_row: this row or status column is not in the item
translation_message_size: A reply must contain 1 to {max} characters to translate.
not_processing: this conversation was not started for an inbox item
cannot_policy: this item cannot get a rule by that
policy_tier: tier must be action, fyi, noise or empty
policy_twin: twin must be first, never or empty
history_limit: limit must be a number from 1 to {max}
history_cursor: before must be an RFC 3339 time, and before_id comes with it
history_zone: tz must be a time zone name, such as Europe/Berlin
bad_folder: folder must have at least one name between the slashes
handoff_kind: kind must be agent or conversation
handoff_record_text: text must be empty when session is set
send_cannot_reply: This can’t be answered from Persona, so nothing was sent. Reply in the app it came from.
send_source_unavailable: The app this came from isn’t connected right now, so nothing was sent. Check that it’s turned on in Settings, or reply in that app.
send_signed_out: You’re signed out of the app this came from, or the sign-in expired, so nothing was sent. Sign in again, then send.
send_denied: The app this came from didn’t allow the reply, so nothing was sent. It may be missing a permission, or the chat may no longer be reachable. Reply in that app instead.
send_rate_limited: The app this came from is limiting how often replies can be sent, so nothing was sent. Try again in a moment.
send_failed: The app this came from couldn’t send the reply, so nothing was sent. Try again, or reply in that app.
send_unrecorded: The reply couldn’t be recorded before sending, so nothing was sent. Try again in a moment.
bot_not_in_chat: The bot is not in this chat. Add it to the group, then try again. Your account was not used.
reply_policy_blocked: Reply policy blocked this owner draft, so nothing was sent.
